items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Eddie Hyman, who's a bass player. I know him.

ctx.x: Who did he have in the rhythm section then?
In the rhythm section, Johnny Frisco and Eddie Hyman, who's a bass player. I know him.
Yeah? Eddie? He played with Buck Banville. Yeah, he played with Buck Banville. Buck's my uncle.
